payload.reason: The evidence provides specific features extracted from text for Named Entity Recognition (NER) and text classification tasks.

claims.text: Features extracted from text include keywords, part-of-speech tags, and previous and next words.
Text features are also derived from clustering similar texts and using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) for classification.
The architecture proposed expands the feature set by clustering features from both images and text, particularly for noisy data like microblogs.
